name: Monalisa Parida

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Monalisa Parida is an English-language poet from Odisha whose work has appeared in journals including International Times and New York Parrot. In a World Poetry Day interview, she traced her interest in poetry to the sounds around her as she grew up: lullabies, her grandmother’s readings, classroom rhymes and songs.

Her Kabita Live poems hold love beside the work of finding a voice. Introspection moves through the hurt of being devalued as a girl towards renewed self-worth; Thread of Love uses a garden, fragrance and a garland to imagine closeness. Echoes of Last!!! takes a different form, setting a father’s presence at a child’s first moments against the child’s presence at his last. Its paired memories make the passage between care and grief sharply felt.
